reviews.name: Ivy W.
reviews.quote: I can’t recommend Horizon Heating and Air Conditioning enough! After I called, Greg was at my door within an hour. He quickly diagnosed the problem and had my air conditioner blowing cold air again in about 20 minutes...

reviews.name: Matthew G.
reviews.quote: ...luckily Kenny called me for an earlier time slot, which worked out perfectly. While he was giving me a quote for a new package unit, he found the problem with my old unit and was instantly able to replace the capacitors, service the unit, and get it up and running...

reviews.name: Thaddeus J.
reviews.quote: ...Greg, the owner, really knows his stuff. He's honest, hardworking, and doesn't mess around when it comes to customer service...
